suppress.notes: FALSE POSITIVE: CVE-2023-36415 (Azure Identity SDK RCE). NVD lists Java as fixed in 1.10.2 (https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2023-36415). The match comes from the JavaScript entry (< 3.3.1) of the same generic azure_identity_sdk CPE; dependency-check ignores the target_sw language. We ship azure-identity 1.18.x.

FALSE POSITIVE: CVE-2026-33117 is in the Azure Key Vault Keys library (azure-security-keyvault-keys < 4.10.6) local cryptography path. NVD uses the generic cpe:2.3:a:microsoft:azure_sdk_for_java CPE, so the versions of unrelated Azure SDK artifacts (azure-core 1.59.x, azure-json 1.5.x, ...) match "< 4.10.6". azure-security-keyvault-keys itself (4.11.x) is not flagged.
FALSE POSITIVE: dev.cel:protobuf is Google CEL's protobuf integration artifact, not protobuf-java. Its version (0.x) is matched against cpe:2.3:a:google:protobuf-java.

FALSE POSITIVE: OpenTelemetry CVEs for other language implementations matched against Java artifacts via the generic cpe:2.3:a:opentelemetry:opentelemetry CPE. CVE-2026-54285: opentelemetry-js (@opentelemetry/core W3CBaggagePropagator), NVD target_sw node.js. CVE-2026-39882: OpenTelemetry-Go OTLP HTTP exporters, NVD target_sw go. CVE-2026-41078: OpenTelemetry .NET Jaeger exporter (OpenTelemetry.Exporter.Jaeger), NVD target_sw .net. CVE-2026-40894: OpenTelemetry .NET OpenTelemetry.Api / Extensions.Propagators, NVD target_sw .net. CVE-2026-41178: OpenTelemetry-Go baggage parsing, NVD target_sw go. CVE-2026-44967: opentelemetry-cpp OTLP HTTP exporters, NVD target_sw c++.

FALSE POSITIVE: CVE-2026-53914 is unsafe deserialization of Kotlin build cache metadata. GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp lists only org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin (< 2.4.20-Beta1) as affected. NVD uses the generic cpe:2.3:a:jetbrains:kotlin (< 2.4.20), which matches the kotlin-stdlib runtime pulled in by okhttp/okio and tuweni.
